name: hybrid-v4
author: Yosif Elessawi
description: Yosif's Hybrid v4: nets trained by self-play and by copying a deeper search, with a search that imagines hidden hands from where its guess net thinks each card is.
method: the bid net picks the bid
the card net keeps its top 2 cards
imagine hidden hands from the guess net, keep those that fit the bids x32
each kept card: the card net plays all 4 seats to the end
